title: Shape-shifting proteins and the subtlety in their form and function.
snippet: Shape-shifting proteins include intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and fold-switching, or metamorphic proteins. They make up a significant fraction of the "dark proteome" in the protein universe.
